name: Calameo

sources.title: Calaméo homepage — digital publishing platform, 'transform your documents into interactive content instantly and for free'

requirements: Free account tier exists — homepage explicitly says publishing is possible 'instantly and for free'
Content must be a document (magazine, catalog, brochure, deck) — Calaméo is a digital publishing platform, not a product directory
The batch-provided signup URL (calameo.com/account/new) is dead — registration entry point is from the homepage/pricing page
preparation: A PDF document to publish — e.g. a product one-pager, catalog, or launch deck
workflow: Open calameo.com and create a free account (signup via homepage CTA or /upgrade page where the free plan is listed)
Upload the PDF; Calaméo converts it to an interactive publication
Publication gets a public page on calameo.com readable without login
watchFor: Batch submission URL 404s — do not rely on it; find current signup from the homepage
'Link detection' feature activates links inside documents — embedded links in the PDF may become clickable in the viewer
Paid plans (/upgrade) add personalization, statistics, subscribers — not required for a public publication
Not a launch directory; value is an indexed publication page + embeddable viewer
countsAsLive: The uploaded publication is publicly readable at a calameo.com/read/... URL and appears on the public account page
unknowns: Current free-plan limits (number of publications, storage)
rel attributes on in-document links after link detection
Exact current signup URL (homepage did not expose it statically)
